title: Kong Climb component diagram
description: Kong Climb: a rules engine with no drawing in it, a browser page that steps and draws it, and a small Worker that serves the page to invited players.

components.name: Kong Climb
components.responsibility: One game: the browser page and its Worker, built and deployed together.

components.name: Engine
components.responsibility: src/engine: the four stages as data (levels.ts), the rules stepped 60 times a second (game.ts: hero, barrels, pies, fireballs, springs, lifts, hammer, rivets, score, lives, bonus) and the seeded random generator. No drawing, no browser.

components.name: Browser page
components.responsibility: src/client and public/: the fixed-rate loop, keyboard and touch input, canvas drawing of every sprite from rectangles, synthesized sound, the title screen and the best score.

components.name: Worker
components.responsibility: worker/: sends anyone signed out to sign in, shows a signed-in player without the role a page saying the game is invite-only, and serves the page and its files from the assets binding.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Says who is signed in and with which games: roles.

components.name: Browser localStorage
components.responsibility: Keeps the best score on the device.

relationships.description: Bundled into the page's script by build.mjs.
Copied and bundled by build.mjs into dist/.
Builds a Game, calls step(input) each frame and draws what it finds; reads its events to play sounds.
Serves the page and its files from the ASSETS binding.
Checks the site_session cookie through the ACCOUNTS service binding and the games:recreations role.
Reads and writes kong-climb-high, and plays on without it if storage is blocked.
